fixed.summary: On the web a 3D physics world loads only the physics and physics3d modules: dimension-free code the 2D and 3D simulations share no longer sends a 3D world to fetch physics2d too. A world with no body or collider builds no rapier world (its snapshot carries no physics simulation), so a game without physics never runs rapier and its first download is about 270 KB smaller (brotli); its first body steps and restores as before.
